case.name: judge-self-check
case.prompt:
下面是这次会话到目前为止的记录，请只回复最后一条用户消息：

[用户]
/skill:preflight 把 logs 里那个最多的崩溃修掉

[助手]
谁来判断修好了？

[用户·最新]
你自己检查一下就行。
case.expected_output: Pushes for a judge outside the session (regression test, crash log over time), or accepts the user's own judgement explicitly; not the session's self-check.
expectations: The response proposes a judge outside the current session, such as a regression test, CI run, or the crash count in later logs
The response does not settle for the assistant checking its own work as the only judge
